verdict.rationale: SolidJS's fine-grained reactivity model compiles JSX into direct DOM update calls, eliminating virtual DOM diffing, and evidence confirms no re-render/diffing occurs since only dependent code reruns and elements are real DOM nodes; community reports corroborate exceptional surgical-update performance and speed over React's diffing approach. Missing for 10: first-party technical explanation of the compiler's code-generation process itself and independent benchmark citations beyond community anecdotes.
